task.title: Remove or reset a setting
task.shortdesc: Remove a configured value or reset it back to the inherited baseline, preset, or unconfigured state.

prereq.p: Open the setting detail panel for a configured value.

context.p: Remove and reset actions are destructive for the selected value, so the user should understand source and downstream effects first.

step.cmd: Inspect the current value and source badge.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Choose Remove or Reset only for the setting you intend to change.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Read any warning or validation message shown by the detail panel.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Save the profile after confirming the value is absent, reset, or inherited as expected.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: The setting no longer applies from the previous configured value.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the removal was unintended, reapply the previous value from history, import, comparison, or a saved source document.
